digest.component_or_area: code-review concurrency overlay LLM eval spec
propositions: A standing eval spec for the code-review concurrency overlay must be authored to prevent silent regression of recall/precision behavior established against traced production bug corpus.

The spec must define scored gating dataset entries including at least 2 recall cases (unlocked twin, check-then-act TOCTOU) and at least 3 no-fire cases with provenance comments naming source commits.
The hard false-positive control case (deliberate probe-then-skip with real lock) must be included as a scored expect:pass case.
The fail-open guard case (R3) must be present as a non-gating documented stretch comment block, not a scored case, so it cannot fail the gate by construction.
The eval harness must enforce deterministic scoring where a gating scorer passes an epoch only if every applicable case passes, with gate tolerance of at_least(2) over 3 epochs.
